title: Reject malformed raw SCHC fragmentation wires on send
description: LinkLayer._send_locked reserves raw payload prefixes 0x78/0x79 for SCHC fragmentation, but an unissued value that is neither a valid control nor a parseable Fragment falls through and is signed/transmitted as ordinary bulk data. For example b'\x78' or a malformed/padded fragment bypasses create_fragment_sender and control validation. The raw fragmentation dispatch should accept only one-use _IssuedFragmentWire values or fully validated directional controls at ACK priority; reject every other 0x78/0x79 payload and add malformed/truncated/padding regression cases.
